==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Hiiva''' translates to "yeast" from Finnish. 
** It originiated from a friend, in exchange for a ''League of Legends'' beta key, if Hiiva would use the word as his summoner name.<ref>[https://youtu.be/6zuc1mI8OSg?t=98 Euro League - Vitality crumble. MVP? Playoff draft gaps. feat. Hiiva & Troubleinc ] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Subbed for [[Gambit Gaming]] for Week 5 of the [[Riot League Championship Series/Europe/2014 Season/Summer Round Robin|EU LCS 2014 Summer Split]].
* Before making a surprising return with [[Misfits Gaming]] in [[LEC/2019 Season/Summer Season|LEC 2019 Summer]], he had previously played 14 games in the EU LCS, all of them losses.
